old: An online petition backing Huang had passed 180,000 signatures, including Elon Musk, TIME and TechCrunch reported.[^4][^5]
new: An online petition backing Huang had passed 180,000 signatures, including Elon Musk, TIME and Al Jazeera reported, while TechCrunch noted that Musk and other tech executives signed it.[^4][^5][^6]
why: TIME and Al Jazeera report the 180,000-signature figure; TechCrunch lists tech executives who signed the petition without giving a signature count.
